questions.question: How many types of the array are there in the C++ programming language?

options.A: There are three types of arrays
options.B: There are four types of arrays
options.C: There are two types of arrays
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Arrays in C++ are broadly of two types: single-dimensional and multi-dimensional arrays.

questions.question: Which SQL statement is used to update data in a database?
questions.explanation: UPDATE modifies existing rows in a table. ALTER changes the table structure (DDL), and CHANGE/MODIFY are clauses used with ALTER TABLE.

questions.concept: Implementing stack, queue and list with arrays
questions.question: Stack, Queue and Linked list can be implemented using
questions.explanation: Stack, queue and linked list can all be implemented using an array (linked list via index-linked nodes). Simple variables cannot hold a collection.

questions.question: Upward multiplexing involves:

options.A: Combining multiple data streams into one
options.B: Distributing data to different physical channels

questions.explanation: Upward multiplexing maps several transport connections (data streams) onto a single network connection. Spreading one connection across several network paths is downward (inverse) multiplexing.

questions.question: Can a DFA recognize a palindrome number?
questions.explanation: The set of palindromes is not regular (pumping lemma); recognising them requires unbounded memory to match the first half with the second. A DFA has finite memory, so it cannot recognise palindromes in general.

questions.question: In an operating system, a "buffer cache" is used to:

options.B: Store copies of frequently used files in memory

questions.explanation: The buffer cache keeps in main memory copies of recently or frequently used disk blocks so repeated accesses avoid slow disk I/O. It does not hold whole file systems, the kernel, or devices.

questions.concept: Type checking and const member functions
questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct about the C++ programming language?

options.A: In C++, both the static and dynamic types checking are allowed.
options.B: In C++, member function are allowed to be of the type const.
options.C: In C++, dynamic checking is allowed.
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: C++ performs static type checking and also dynamic checking (e.g. dynamic_cast, RTTI), and member functions can be declared const. Since all statements are true, more than one option is correct.

questions.question: Which SQL clause is used to retrieve specific rows from a table?
questions.explanation: SELECT (with a WHERE clause) retrieves specific rows from a table. SEARCH and FIND are not SQL clauses, and FETCH is used with cursors or to limit rows, not as the retrieval statement.

questions.question: The Floyd-Warshall algorithm is a popular method for solving the All-Pair Shortest Paths problem. What is the time complexity of the Floyd-Warshall algorithm for a graph with "n" vertices?
questions.explanation: Floyd-Warshall uses three nested loops over the n vertices (intermediate, source, destination), giving O(n^3). O(n^2) is only the space needed for the distance matrix.

questions.question:
This is an Assertion and Reason type question. Select the most suitable option considering the Assertion and Reason.
Assertion (A): It becomes difficult to update and maintain a website's design using CSS.
Reason (R): CSS allows web developers to separate the presentation layer (styles and layout) from the content layer (HTML).

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.explanation: Because CSS separates presentation from content (R true), it makes a website's design easier, not harder, to update and maintain, so A is false.

questions.question:
This is an Assertion and Reason type question. Select the most suitable option considering the Assertion and Reason.
Assertion (A): FTP is a networking protocol used for transferring files.
Reason (R): FTP is used when we want to view some data from a website.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A)
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.explanation: FTP is indeed a protocol for transferring files, so A is true. Viewing data from a website is done through HTTP/HTTPS, so R is false.

questions.question: Microcontrollers find application in various fields. What is a typical application of microcontrollers in the automotive industry?
questions.explanation: Cars use microcontroller-based Engine Control Units (ECUs) to manage fuel injection, ignition timing and similar functions. Airplane entertainment systems are not automotive.

questions.question:
What will be the output of the following code segment?
a = 5
def func_1(b=10):
    global a
    a = b - 10
    b += a
    print(a, b)
func_1(a)
questions.explanation: func_1(5) sets the global a = 5 - 10 = -5, then b = 5 + (-5) = 0, so it prints -5 0. The default b=10 is not used because 5 is passed.

questions.question: Each ___ represents a particular colour.
questions.explanation: Each pixel value encodes the colour (or intensity) of one point in an image. A frame is a whole image in a video sequence.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is completely true?
I. In an object-oriented programming language, all the function calls are resolved at compile-time.
II. In a procedure programming language, all the function calls are resolved at compile-time.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In procedural languages function calls are bound at compile time, but in OOP languages virtual function calls are resolved at runtime (dynamic binding), so statement I is false. Only II is true.

questions.question: What is an encryption system that uses two keys: a public key that everyone can have and a private key for only the recipient?
questions.explanation: Public key (asymmetric) encryption uses a public key for encryption and a private key, held only by the recipient, for decryption. 'Encryption' alone is too general.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a feature of DBMS?

options.A: Minimum duplication and redundancy of data
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A DBMS supports concurrent multi-user access, so 'single-user access only' is not a feature. Reduced redundancy and high security are DBMS features.

questions.question: What is the primary goal of software engineering?

options.B: To develop software that meets user requirements within budget and schedule constraints
options.C: To develop software with the latest technologies
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Software engineering aims to deliver quality software that meets user requirements within budget and schedule. Efficient coding and new technologies are only means, not the primary goal.

questions.question: If a robot is able to change its own trajectory as per the external conditions, then the robot is considered as the ____ robot.
questions.explanation: A robot that senses external conditions and adapts its own trajectory is an intelligent robot. Open-loop and non-servo robots follow fixed motions without feedback, and 'mobile' only describes locomotion.

questions.question: Which of the following Excel screen components cannot be turned on or off?
questions.explanation: Formula bar, status bar and toolbars can all be turned on or off from the View menu, so none of these is the answer.

questions.question: Stack works on the principle of:
questions.explanation: A stack inserts and removes elements at the same end (top), so the last element in is the first out. FIFO describes a queue.

questions.question: A Language for which DFA exist is a________
questions.explanation: A language is regular if and only if some DFA accepts it. Non-regular languages have no DFA.

questions.question: In Boolean algebra A.A is equal to
questions.explanation: By the idempotent law A.A = A (AND of a variable with itself). Boolean algebra has no 2A or A^2 terms, and A.A = 1 only if A = 1.

questions.question: Which of the following is a common file operation?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Create, delete and rename are all common file operations provided by the operating system.

questions.question: Which network device serves as the entry and exit point of a network, as all data coming in or going out of a network must first pass through it?
questions.explanation: A gateway is the entry and exit point of a network; all traffic entering or leaving passes through it, and it can translate between different networks. A repeater only regenerates signals within a segment.
